summary: Scopic is a global software development company that crafts secure, AI-enabled solutions to fuel business growth. With 20 years of experience, they have delivered over 1,500 projects across 90+ countries, serving various industries with custom software development, digital marketing, and emerging technologies.

East Agile is a GenAI driven development consultancy that provides AI driven development, eXtreme Programming, Scalable Analytics, and Lean Product Management services to startups and enterprise companies. They have worked with over 121 clients in the last 22 years, delivering highly reliable products and raising $1.5 billion in venture capital globally.
